Dichotomization

Source: R/dicho.R
dicho.Rd

This function takes a real value and converts it to 1 if it is positive and else to 0.

Usage

dicho(val)

Arguments

val

A real value

Value

0 or 1.

See also

ifelse

Author

Frédéric Bertrand
frederic.bertrand@lecnam.net
https://fbertran.github.io/homepage/

Examples


dimX <- 6
Astar <- 4
(dataAstar4 <- t(replicate(10,simul_data_YX(dimX,Astar))))
